model.summary: Model favors DET by 4.6 points (62% win chance). Biggest factors: Elo rating (DET +2.6), Rest days (home minus away) (TB +1.6), Quarterback rating (DET +1.4). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 48.6 total points (DET 27, TB 22). Biggest factors: Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (lowers total 0.8), Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 0.7), Natural grass field (raises total 0.6). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.

qb_what_if.note: Approximate: swaps only the quarterback rating and the model's QB-change flag (a new starter counts as a change). Team offense and defense form stay as they are. A positive margin change favors the home team.
